title: ProspeCtive study for autOmated annulaR and atrial suturing systems using RAM® and C1™ technology to assist in minimally invasive mitral valve replacement
summary:
40 Patients with mitral valve pathology, who are planned for minimally invasive mitral valve replacement surgery at the Department of Cardiac Surgery in Bonn will be included in this study with respect to the inclusion and exclusion criteria. The patients will undergo surgery using a specified automated annular and remote atrial suturing system for placement of the annular pledgeted sutures and closure of the left atrium using a 
minimally-invasive access (anterolateral thoracotomy). Patients will be compared to a 
historical cohort of 40 patients undergoing minimally-invasive mitral valve replacement 
without this suturing technology.

interventions.name: Mitral valve surgery in patients with mitral valve pathologies using RAM® and C1™ technology.
Comparison with a histological cohort of patients who underwent mitral valve surgery without the use of C1™ and RAM® technology.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with: mitral valve pathology and indication for replacement 
Life expectancy >1 year
Patients willing and able to sign the informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
Emergency procedures
Patient who did not sign the informed consent form and/ or refuse to participate Patients unable to read or understand the informed consent
